items.name: ability-ants-volatile-draught
items.refnote: the first image is the Royal Alchemist: use only the design of the flasks it carries (round glass, gold-wrapped neck, glowing violet liquid); do not draw the Alchemist.
items.subject: VOLATILE DRAUGHT: one round-bellied glass flask with a gold-wrapped neck and an amber resin stopper, full of glowing violet liquid, hurled through the air from the lower left to the upper right, one bright crack across its glass and one short violet streak behind it. Energy colour: violet.

items.name: ability-ants-unstable
items.refnote: the first image is the Burster: draw only its round abdomen sac, keeping its design and materials; not the rest of the ant.
items.subject: UNSTABLE: the Burster's round abdomen sac alone, seen from the front, a taut translucent sphere full of glowing violet liquid bound by a cross of royal-blue silk straps, one bright jagged crack of light across its front where it is about to burst.

items.name: ability-ants-alchemist-crystallise
items.subject: CRYSTALLISE, encases a unit in hardened substance: one tall, smooth, upright teardrop of hardened glossy golden-amber resin, tilted slightly, with the dark silhouette of a small insect sealed inside it, legs drawn in, a cold white gloss streak down its lit side. Only the sealed drop: no flask, no caster. Energy colour: amber gold.

items.name: ability-ants-alchemist-transfusion
items.subject: TRANSFUSION, drains an enemy's life into a wounded ally: one thick, bold S-shaped ribbon of glowing liquid flowing from the lower left to the upper right, deep crimson-red at its tail turning into warm golden light at its head, three round drops along it. Only the stream: no flask, no bodies, no caster. Energy colour: crimson turning gold.

items.name: ability-ants-alchemist-overdose
items.refnote: the first image is the Royal Alchemist: take only the sand-and-bronze chitin of its forelimbs and claws; draw neither the Alchemist nor its flasks.
items.subject: OVERDOSE, the Alchemist's ultimate: allies swell with substance, faster and stronger but burning their own health. One sand-and-bronze ant forelimb with a three-clawed grip thrust diagonally upward, clenched, its chitin cracking along swollen seams from which hot orange-magenta light blazes out. Only the limb: no flask, no sphere, no ant. Energy colour: hot orange and magenta.

items.name: ability-ants-queen-royal-jelly
items.subject: ROYAL JELLY, heals an ally and strengthens it: one big, fat, glossy teardrop of glowing golden royal jelly falling diagonally toward the lower right, a smaller drop behind it, warm light inside it and a bright white highlight on its lit side. Only the drops: no hand, no Queen, no bowl. Energy colour: warm gold.

items.name: ability-ants-queen-one-body
items.refnote: the first image is the Queen: take only the heart-shaped violet flame on her staff and her royal-blue and gold materials; do not draw the Queen or the staff.
items.subject: ONE BODY, the colony is one body and allies near the Queen take less damage: a calm, symmetric heart-shaped emblem built of interlocking royal-blue chitin plates, each plate edged in gold trim, a small glowing violet heart-shaped flame at its centre like the one on the Queen's staff. Energy colour: royal blue and gold.

items.name: ability-ants-queen-exodus
items.subject: EXODUS, the Queen's ultimate: she and her army sink underground and come up elsewhere. One round sculpted sand-clay tunnel mouth seen at an angle from above, its thick rim edged in gold, a deep swirling vortex of glowing violet light spiralling down into it. Only the tunnel mouth: no ants, no ground around it. Energy colour: violet.

items.name: ability-ants-general-mandible-charge
items.refnote: the first image is the General: take only the bronze chitin of its head and mandibles; do not draw its body, banner or glaive.
items.subject: MANDIBLE CHARGE, the General rushes and seizes an enemy: a pair of huge curved ivory mandibles with bronze bases lunging diagonally toward the upper right, snapping shut, one bold orange impact flash between their tips and short orange speed streaks behind. Only the mandibles: no body, no blades. Energy colour: orange.

items.name: ability-ants-general-mark-prey
items.subject: MARK PREY, marks an enemy to take more damage: the domed back of a dark black enemy beetle shell seen from above at an angle, a single thick ring of glowing crimson-red hunting scent daubed boldly onto it like wet paint, one drip running down. Only the shell and its mark. Energy colour: crimson red.

items.name: ability-ants-general-war-column
items.refnote: the first image is the General: draw only the banner on its back, keeping its shape and materials; not the General.
items.subject: WAR COLUMN, the General's aura that speeds allies and raises their damage: the General's tall leaf-shaped royal-blue war banner, hanging straight and still from a bronze crossbar on a bronze pole with a gold spearhead tip, gold trim and a gold leaf vein down the cloth. Seen from the front, symmetric. Energy colour: royal blue and gold.

items.name: ability-ants-general-bivouac
items.subject: BIVOUAC, the General's ultimate: the army locks into a living fortress that takes far less damage and hurts attackers. One closed dome of overlapping thick bronze chitin shell plates, like a carapace fortress, a ring of short ivory mandible spikes jutting outward around its base, cold steel-white highlights on its plate edges. Only the dome. Energy colour: cold steel-white.

items.name: ability-ants-reaver-devour
items.refnote: the first image is the Reaver Queen: take only her huge hooked mandibles and bronze chitin; do not draw the rest of her.
items.subject: DEVOUR, swallows an enemy whole to heal: two enormous hooked bronze mandibles with jagged inner teeth seen from the side, closing diagonally around the small black shell of an enemy beetle, a dark crimson-red glow between the jaws. Only the jaws and their prey. Energy colour: crimson red.

items.name: ability-ants-reaver-molt
items.refnote: the first image is the Reaver Queen: take only the design of her bronze armour plates; do not draw her body.
items.subject: MOLT, the Reaver Queen sheds her old carapace to heal and run faster: one thick, old, cracked bronze carapace plate split open down its middle like a shell, a soft, fresh, glowing pale-gold new shell bulging out through the split. Only the plate. Energy colour: pale gold and white.

items.name: ability-ants-reaver-rampage
items.refnote: the first image is the Reaver Queen: draw only her armoured head and its front spines, keeping their design; not her body, legs or cape.
items.subject: RAMPAGE, the Reaver Queen charges and stuns everything around her target: her armoured bronze head, crowned by its tall curved spines, driving diagonally toward the upper right like a battering ram, one bold orange shock crescent bursting ahead of it and dust streaks behind. Only the head. Energy colour: orange.

items.name: ability-ants-reaver-ravenous
items.refnote: the first image is the Reaver Queen: draw only her mandibles and mouth, seen from the front; not her body.
items.subject: RAVENOUS, the mutated Reaver Queen starves and loses health every second: her gaping maw seen straight from the front, symmetric, the ring of hooked bronze mandibles wide open around a dark empty throat, thick drops of glowing violet liquid drooling from the jaws. Energy colour: violet.

items.name: ability-ants-reaver-royal-presence
items.refnote: the first image is the Reaver Queen: take only her tall curved back spines with their inset glowing gems; do not draw her.
items.subject: ROYAL PRESENCE, the Reaver Queen's aura that makes ants attack faster: a crown of five tall curved bronze spines fanned out symmetrically from a royal-blue base, each spine inset with one glowing oval blue gem, seen from the front, a warm golden glow behind it. Only the crown of spines. Energy colour: warm gold and royal blue.

items.name: ability-ants-herald-alarm
items.refnote: the first image is the Herald: draw only its fanned crest of golden feathers; do not draw the Herald or its staff, and make the flames orange-red, not violet.
items.subject: ALARM, rallies allies to fight harder and faster: the Herald's crest of tall golden feather-antennae raised in a wide upright fan, each feather tip blazing with a bright orange-red flame, a royal-blue helmet band at its base. Only the crest: no head, no staff. Energy colour: blazing orange-red.

items.name: ability-ants-herald-panic
items.subject: PANIC, a fear-scent that stops enemies attacking or casting: one big billowing cloud of sour violet-magenta pheromone mist shaped like a menacing ant head with two dark hollow eye holes and open mandibles, rounded and puffy, fading at its lower edge. Only the cloud. Energy colour: sour violet-magenta.

items.name: ability-ants-herald-trail
items.subject: TRAIL, a pheromone trail that speeds allies: one bold swooping ribbon of glowing sky-blue pheromone mist curving from the lower left to the upper right like a comet's tail, thin at its start and widening to a bright white-hot head. Only the ribbon: no ants, no footprints, no ground. Energy colour: sky blue and white.

items.name: ability-ants-gardener-fungus-circle
items.refnote: the first image is the Gardener: take only the design of its mushrooms (the cream cap with a royal-blue rim); do not draw the Gardener.
items.subject: FUNGUS CIRCLE, a ring of fungus that heals allies standing in it: a closed ring of five chunky glowing mushrooms with cream caps rimmed in royal blue, seen from slightly above, a soft warm golden healing light rising from the centre of the ring. Only the ring. Energy colour: warm gold and cream.

items.name: ability-ants-gardener-spore-cloud
items.refnote: the first image is the Gardener: draw only its big cream mushroom-cap hat with the royal-blue rim, as a mushroom; not the Gardener.
items.subject: SPORE CLOUD, choking spores that slow enemies' attacks and movement: one big round cream mushroom cap with a royal-blue rim, tilted toward the upper right, puffing out from beneath it a single thick billowing plume of glowing violet spores. Only the cap and its plume. Energy colour: violet.

items.name: ability-ants-bullet-agony
items.refnote: the first image is the Bullet Ant: draw only the tip of its abdomen and its violet stinger, keeping their design; not the whole ant.
items.subject: AGONY, the most painful sting in the forest: the Bullet Ant's segmented dark oxblood-red abdomen tip seen close up, its long glowing violet stinger stabbing steeply down toward the lower right, one bold white-violet flash of pain at its point. Only the stinger and abdomen tip. Energy colour: searing violet and white.

items.name: ability-ants-bullet-giant-killer
items.refnote: the first image is the Bullet Ant: take only its gold-tipped oxblood mandibles; do not draw the ant, its mane or its legs.
items.subject: GIANT KILLER, Bullet Ants deal extra damage to heroes and big units: a pair of curved dark oxblood mandibles with gold tips, seen from the front, symmetric, clamped around a huge black beetle horn standing upright between them, the horn cracking across its middle. Energy colour: gold.

items.name: ability-ants-burster-rupture
items.refnote: the first image is the Burster: take only the royal-blue silk straps and the violet liquid of its sac; do not draw the Burster or an intact sac.
items.subject: RUPTURE, the Burster bursts on the spot: one bold star-shaped splash of exploding liquid, a white-hot orange core flinging out six thick violet liquid spurts with round drops at their ends, two torn royal-blue silk straps flying apart. Only the burst: no ant, no whole sac. Energy colour: orange-white with violet.

items.name: ability-ants-major-guard
items.refnote: the first image is the Major: draw only its leaf-shaped royal-blue shield; not the Major or its club.
items.subject: GUARD, small ants near a Major take less damage: the Major's tall leaf-shaped royal-blue shield seen straight from the front, symmetric, its thick cream rim and gold leaf veins, a calm warm golden glow close behind it. Only the shield. Energy colour: royal blue and warm gold.

items.name: ability-ants-major-plug
items.refnote: the first image is the Major: take only its domed armoured head; do not draw its body, shield or club.
items.subject: PLUG, the Major plants its head like a door: its huge domed sand-and-bronze armoured head seen from the front, wedged tightly into a round sand-clay tunnel mouth that frames it, one arrow glancing off its dome in a bright cold steel-white spark. Only the head in its tunnel mouth. Energy colour: cold steel-white.

items.name: ability-ants-raider-frenzy
items.refnote: the first image is the Raider: take only the two royal-blue blade fins on its back; do not draw the ant.
items.subject: FRENZY, Raiders fighting together grow stronger: the Raider's two long royal-blue blade fins with bronze rims crossed in a bold X, seen from the front, their edges glowing hot red-orange, a faint hot glow behind the crossing. Only the fins. Energy colour: hot red-orange.

items.name: ability-ants-needler-barbed-needles
items.refnote: the first image is the Needler: take only one of its bronze spines with the violet tip; do not draw the Needler.
items.subject: BARBED NEEDLES, each hit lowers the target's armour: one thick reddish-bronze chitin needle standing upright with three backward-hooked barbs and a glowing violet tip, driven through a dark steel-grey armour plate that cracks around it, seen from the front. Energy colour: violet.

items.name: ability-ants-found
items.refnote: the first image is the Alate: take only its translucent royal-blue veined wings; do not draw the Alate.
items.subject: FOUND, an Alate raises a new Brood Mound: one small sculpted sand-clay mound spire rising upright with a glowing warm-gold oval tunnel mouth in its front, two shed translucent royal-blue veined wings crossed behind it. Only the spire and its wings: no ant, no ground. Energy colour: warm gold.
